svg.aria-label: S2 The integer register file, register by register
svg.text: S2 The integer register file, register by register
A template that the Passages player fills in: it writes a physical register's name in its cell (p100) and marks it ready. The immediate registers and the free list sit beside the file.
Rename writes a MOV's immediate here,
so the MOV needs no integer unit.
Rename takes one register per result.
A register comes back when the next write
to the same architectural register retires.
Ports per bank are not published.
A bypass returns the last result.
An operand is read at issue.
~ inferred: patent reading or author reasoning
